summary: Executed targeted backend+frontend regression for Super Admin Team Accounts (/super-admin/admins, /api/super-admin/accounts) and auth playbook checks using preview URL from frontend/.env. Super admin login/UI flow passed, but critical backend/security issues found in CORS behavior and account filtering.

critical.issue: CORS preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for both trusted and untrusted origins, and does not return explicit trusted origin with credentials policy.
Returns inactive admin/user accounts (found 2 inactive records) instead of only active accounts.

minor.issue: Legacy compatible endpoint also includes inactive admins because query filters only by role/is_deleted, not is_active.

design_issues.screen: Super Admin Team Accounts - Add account dialog
issues: Console warnings: missing Dialog description/aria-describedby (accessibility warning).

action_items: Fix CORS at ingress/proxy path so preflight returns explicit trusted origin (not *) and correctly enforces untrusted-origin rejection for auth flows.
Update /api/super-admin/accounts query to include active-only filtering (e.g., is_active != false) and keep excluding super_admin/password_hash.
Update legacy /api/super-admin/admins similarly to avoid returning inactive admins while preserving compatibility.
Run safe controlled verification for account creation+email delivery in a non-shared mailbox strategy; current run intentionally skipped live create due side-effect risk.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend app code configures explicit CORS origins with allow_credentials=True, but observed live behavior returns wildcard (*) headers; likely edge/proxy override and security-policy drift.
In modules/superadmin/router_organizations.py, /super-admin/accounts and /super-admin/admins use filters without is_active check, causing deactivated accounts to remain visible.

Playbook check 'seed_admin updates existing admin if password changed' could not be validated via app startup path; seed_esg_superadmin.py is non-idempotent for password updates (existing user is skipped).
No APIs were MOCKED in this run.
seed_data_creation: None. Did not create live test user/admin accounts due invitation email side-effect safety blocker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_super_admin_accounts_iter42.py for regression. Repros: (1) OPTIONS /api/auth/login returns wildcard CORS headers for both trusted and untrusted origins on preview URL; (2) GET /api/super-admin/accounts includes inactive admins (sample ids observed: 6bf28a6b-f1bf-44eb-b1bd-10d392760729, f8d6252c-8028-47bb-9996-6a05a14b462a). UI /super-admin/admins renders and Add account modal role/org selectors work without save.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 CORS: Runtime backend code enforces explicit origins, but external preflight responses are wildcard (*) with permissive methods/headers, indicating gateway/edge-level CORS handling supersedes backend middleware. This breaks credentialed-auth origin restrictions. Mitigation: disable/align edge CORS policy with backend explicit-origin config. RCA-2 Account list: /super-admin/accounts DB filter omits is_active, so soft-deactivated users remain in response; same pattern in legacy /super-admin/admins. Mitigation: add is_active active-only filter while keeping role/is_deleted constraints.
